acceptanceCriteria: Android host injects a real handler: photo/archive imports return only app-owned paths, permission request uses the existing stateful service, settings opens the app settings page, and privacy opens only a nonblank configured HTTPS URL.

iOS exports a stable Kotlin bridge implemented by Swift for photo/archive picking, notification permission, system settings and HTTPS privacy; cancellation and native failures do not overwrite a field, and document/photo results use owned file URLs accepted by the existing iOS ports.

Android/iOS privacy configuration remains an external template contract and is safe-disabled when absent. No live URL, Firebase project, Yandex iOS project/ad unit, SDK initialization, publication or scope expansion is introduced.
Existing typed platform-result routing remains the only field-update boundary and native cancellation/failure never overwrites the form state.
No data/domain/component/root/theme behavior or Paparazzi baselines are changed; specialist does not run Gradle.
goal: Inject production Android and iOS platform handlers for every typed platform action, open only externally configured HTTPS privacy URLs, preserve cancel/failure safely, and keep iOS advertising disabled.
